title: FAQ Admin 基礎建設：字典 + 導航 + 共用表單元件
content:
建立 FAQ 管理系統所需的基礎設施，供後續子卡片使用。

範圍：
1. 字典檔：在 en.json / zh-hk.json / zh-cn.json 新增 admin.faq.* 區段（~30 個 key）
   - faq, faqList, newCategory, editCategory, newQuestion, editQuestion
   - categoryNameZh/En/ZhCn, categoryOrder
   - questionCategory, questionZh/En/ZhCn, answerZh/En/ZhCn
   - isPublished, unpublished
   - noCategories, noQuestions, deleteCategoryWarning, deleteQuestionWarning
   - toastCategoryCreated/Updated/Deleted, toastQuestionCreated/Updated/Deleted, toastTogglePublished
   - saveCategory, saveQuestion, createCategory, createQuestion
   - confirmDeleteCategory, confirmDeleteQuestion, questionsCount
2. types.ts：將 admin.faq 的 keys 納入 AdminDict（不需新 slice 型別，AdminDict 已是 Dictionary['admin']）
3. AdminLayoutClient.tsx：在 NAV_ITEMS 新增 FAQ 導航項目
   - { key: "faq", href: "/faq", icon: HelpCircle }
   - 需 import HelpCircle from lucide-react
4. FaqCategoryForm.tsx：共用類別表單元件（src/components/admin/）
   - Props: mode: "create" | "edit", initialData?, onSuccess?
   - 欄位：nameZh, nameEn, nameZhCn, order (number)
   - Zod 驗證：generalFaqCategoryCreateSchema
   - POST /api/admin/faq/categories 或 PATCH /api/admin/faq/categories/[id]
   - 遵循 CourseForm 模式：useState, handleChange, useAdminDict, useToast, useRouter
   - 三欄 grid 布局（nameZh/En/ZhCn）+ order input
5. FaqQuestionForm.tsx：共用問題表單元件（src/components/admin/）
   - Props: mode: "create" | "edit", categories: Category[] (for selector), initialData?, onSuccess?
   - 欄位：categoryId (select), questionZh/En/ZhCn, answerZh/En/ZhCn, isPublished (toggle)
   - Zod 驗證：generalFaqCreateSchema
   - POST /api/admin/faq 或 PATCH /api/admin/faq/[id]
   - 跟 CourseForm 完全一致的 input/label/error/section styling class

依賴：AF-001-B, AF-001-C（API routes 已就緒）
acceptance: en.json / zh-hk.json / zh-cn.json 皆有完整的 admin.faq 區段
FAQ 導航項出現在 Admin 側邊欄，點擊到 /en/admin/faq (或 zh-hk/zh-cn)
FaqCategoryForm 可獨立渲染，支援 create/edit mode，表單檢核正確
FaqQuestionForm 可獨立渲染，category selector 列出所有類別，表單檢核正確
兩個 form 元件都會發出正確的 POST/PATCH API 呼叫
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && check sidebar has FAQ link, forms mount without crash
